description: Long CV spanning more than 18 years across 6 roles, with substantial text intended to exceed two pages. Prioritize management evidence while preserving employers, chronology, and stated scope.

My current work combines direct management of engineers with partnership across product, support, and security. I focus on making ownership clear, helping engineers make decisions, and matching delivery commitments to the maintenance work a team must sustain. I remain comfortable reviewing technical proposals and investigating service behavior, while leaving implementation decisions with the engineers responsible for the work.

Mentored engineers preparing for senior responsibilities by reviewing their technical proposals, observing stakeholder discussions, and giving specific feedback on decision making and follow-through.
Reduced repeat order-import incidents from 14 to 5 per quarter, based on incident records, by prioritizing validation errors and clearer recovery controls for support staff.
Partnered with a product designer to observe warehouse staff using exception screens, then translated the confusing steps into scoped changes that engineers could deliver incrementally.
Documented ownership of shared services and negotiated maintenance responsibilities with neighboring teams when changes to catalog data affected order processing and warehouse allocation.
Revised the team's release checklist after a failed deployment so database compatibility, support readiness, and recovery instructions were reviewed before changes reached customer environments.
